decision.reason_code: G6 wrong-layer / different-taxonomy + different zone universe
decision.reason: The live AGOL Zonage_SHY (ETQ_ZONE = NO_ZONE + CODE_AFFEC) is NOT the same layer the served collection was derived from (the CITY ISOGEO server arcgis.st-hyacinthe.ca FeatureServer/13, zone_code = NUM_ZONE + GROUPE_USAGE_DOM). Exact code overlap is only ~22% (852/1089 served codes have no upstream match — reproduces the prior held's 852). Even on the bare zone NUMBER, overlap is only ~58% (460 served numbers absent upstream, 439 live numbers absent from served; served-only numbers confirmed count=0 upstream). Where numbers match, the suffix disagrees 62% of the time because the suffix attributes differ (dominant-usage-group vs affectation-designation; disjoint vocab items 'X' vs 'Z/ZR/AA/AC/AH/AHC/RA'). Forcing this replacement would drop 852 served codes as UNKNOWN and re-key the collection into an incompatible taxonomy — the exact wrong-layer forced replacement the policy forbids.
decision.served_unproven_note: The REPLACE-policy precondition (every uncovered served code UNPROVEN) IS met (level=candidate, url declarative, featureHasV2Proof=0/1091). But unproven-ness is NECESSARY, not SUFFICIENT — the G6 wrong-layer guard overrides: low overlap + divergent taxonomy + divergent zone universe = do NOT force.
decision.recommended_reconciliation_path_NOT_an_a: The identity-clean v2 source is the SAME layer the served zone_code was derived from: arcgis.st-hyacinthe.ca/server/rest/services/ISOGEO_SigimProd_Features/FeatureServer/13 (NUM_ZONE + GROUPE_USAGE_DOM). A v2 capture there would upgrade the same identity candidate->documented WITHOUT dropping codes. It requires its own identity + verifiable-complete check (out of scope here). The AGOL ETQ_ZONE dataset is a distinct, non-substitutable dataset (its ETQ_ZONE is the authoritative official grille code, but for a DIFFERENT zone catalog than the currently served one).
decision.geometry_grain_if_ever_deposited: zone-polygon (both the AGOL candidate and the served collection are native zone polygons; grain is NOT the blocker — identity/taxonomy is).
